cause: Cancellation gate required a neutral movement-key frame, blocking held WASD/arrows and fresh mode selection while movement was held.
fix: Allow movement keys during active fire-release gate; exclude movement keys from modal release condition; preserve dead/menu/focus and stale-fire protection.

baselineReproduction.expectedFailure: holding movement key does not prevent choosing a mission after cancellation
baselineReproduction.method: Same harness with Input from delivered V9, whose blob matches pinned GitHub HEAD; compiled to separate scratch directory, no runtime files swapped.
